snippet.title: Swarmslam - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE CORE to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT

Play the Demo and Wishlist Swarmslam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4866530/Swarmslam_Demo/
